//: Zeus tower - a 150-tile solid stone spire on an open plain (Stages 'hill'). The stage id and file names are kept as the encounter's proper noun so nothing downstream has to be renamed. Geometry: 37 tiles across where it meets the ground plane at world tile y 13, tapering three rows of rise per tile of run per side until it is 11 across, then running straight up as a needle to the summit at y -137 where the statue stands. The tip is bare: an 11-wide summit cannot carry a rim wall without putting it between the statue and everything off to the side, and every Zeus laser gates on line of sight. It is solid all the way through - no interior, no stairs, no decks: the outside face is the route. AUTHORED BY GENERATOR: run scripts/gen-tower.py to rebuild every hill_*.txt from the geometry constants; do not hand-edit them. Rules cover only what a list of axis-aligned half-planes can say - the ground plane, the two outer walls that stop a knockback launch leaving the world, and open sky above the summit; a width that is a function of height is not expressible there, hence the generator. Extents 9 because the tower spans chunk rows -9..0. Statue and flock placement lives in Stage.cs.
